lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the gill region. A primary column contains four distinct nodes, followed by a secondary column with three discernible nodes in a roughly linear vertical arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern along the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with light-toned crests and shadowed troughs.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple high-intensity white linear filaments or streaks are present across the mid-lateral and dorsal surfaces, consistent with external parasitic attachments or superficial lesions.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced curvilinear caustic light patterns from surface refraction are superimposed across the dorsal and lateral pixel regions.
